notes: Durations carry +-1 analysis frame of capture jitter and 2-3 frame quantisation (24 fps material on the 60 fps grid).
Typography stills are named type/v5c5-S<n>-*; tracker samples are scratch/v5c5_*.csv (renamed from A_/B_/C_/D_/E_ prefixes; curve sidecars updated).
Every bezier in this chunk fits its samples with a direct residual <= 0.034 (counter-shift 0.062); shape rmse above 0.05 comes from 24 fps sampling at the 2 % window ends.

Per-line counter-tapered display type throughout: in each 2-line headline or title pair one line grows and the other shrinks left to right (S1: 12.3 -> 16.3 % and 14.3 -> 11.2 % H; S3: 5.8 -> 3.5 % and 4.9 -> 9.7 % H; S5: 7.7 -> 11.2 % and 8.9 -> 4.8 % H). In S5 the taper is not a static end state: both titles slide in flat and swing into it as they land (f3740-3752, f3745-3762, v5.3d-perspective-swing), right after the cards do the mirror swing (f3730-3745, f3732-3750).
Elements arrive in mirrored pairs from opposite sides: headline lines (S1, S3), streaks and titles (S5), cards (S5).
The UI cursor is a screen-fixed layer: it does not move with the canvas during the whip-tilt f3225-3256.

No strong audio onset falls near the S1-S3 graphic events; offsets are to beats (32.74 frames). Events within +-2 frames of a beat: headline lock f3052, words f3150/f3177/f3181, press f3212-3215, label blob f3305, thumbnail f3340, cut f3507, caption peaks f3537/f3655, lower streak f3725.

S5 continues into v5c6; in its hold f3762-f3886 cards and titles stay put (titles at most 3 px, card frames within 2 px) but the background light ribbons keep drifting (v5.bg-ribbon-drift), so the frame is never fully still.

S5 entrance curves were re-measured on swing-free readings (card 1's centre, card 2's right-end top edge, title 1's constant-width band edge, title 2's ink centre); the earlier edge readings counted part of the perspective swing as overshoot.

S1: the outer cards' turn and the send button's tilt are part of the camera moves' choreography: the turn starts inside the reframe-up and is undone inside the pull-back; the button arrives already tilted and stays so.

S1 headline exit: line 1 leaves with the camera tilt (gone f3097); line 2 stays cut off by the top edge (lowest 43-46 px of its letters) until f3129 and leaves upward in 2 pictures (f3130-3134, gone f3135) on the prompt pill's first fade-in pictures (v5.text-edge-peek-exit); cut candidate c089 and the f3132 motion peak fall on this exit step.

The S2->S3 whip exit is not a rigid move: from f3297 the panel's outline goes soft and bulges where the footage is bright (v5.fx-liquid-edge-wobble), while the arrival whip f3225-3242 keeps a straight, sharp outline (f3235: sides within 0.4 px).
